name: envelope-unknown-rename-operation
description: A `rename` request. `rename` is not in the protocol at all (an identity change is a `remove` and a `create`) — the envelope has no branch for it, and no implementation can quietly add one back without changing the schema.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` model. `rename-swc-via-remove-create-and-reference-updates.json` is the accepted way to express this same intent: a `remove`, a `create` and one explicit `update` per referring element, in one change set.

expected.notes: The request discriminator is closed to `discover`, `read` and `change_set`, and a change set's operations to `create`, `update` and `remove`. A dedicated rename would have to decide inside the protocol whether to cascade into every referencing element — precisely the class of change the review boundary exists to show the user rather than perform on their behalf.
